critical_assumptions.name: $24K Annual WTP for Growth Tier
critical_assumptions.hypothesis: People Ops managers at Series B-D companies are willing to pay $24K/year for the Growth tier
what_to_listen_for: We spend more on X already
Asks about payment terms (not cost justification)
refute_signals: We'd need to go much lower

critical_assumptions.name: $25K Signing Authority
critical_assumptions.hypothesis: VP People has unilateral signing authority for $25K spend without CFO escalation
critical_assumptions.validation_question: Do you have authority for $24K, or CFO sign-off needed?
what_to_listen_for: I can approve up to $50K on my own
I'm the P&L owner for People operations
My VP sign-off is all we need
Prospect is clearly confident in their authority
gray_signals: My CFO usually reviews 20K+, but we can probably get approved
I'd loop in finance, but I drive the decision
refute_signals: This would need to go through procurement

critical_assumptions.name: 14-17 Day Procurement Cycle
critical_assumptions.hypothesis: Series B-D companies can move from agreement to contract in 14-17 days
critical_assumptions.validation_question: What's your typical vendor procurement cycle?
what_to_listen_for: We use a standard MSA, so signature is quick
gray_signals: Normally 3-4 weeks, but could be faster if prioritized
Depends on legal review, could be 2-3 weeks
We try to keep it under 20 days
refute_signals: Legal review alone takes a month
We move slowly on new vendors

phases.name: Discovery & Pain Mapping
phases.objective: Understand process, map pain to 3 pillars
key_questions: Walk me through your current swag/merch process
What's the biggest headache in that process?
How important is brand alignment? Do you have brand guidelines?
What's your typical order size? MOQs an issue?
If you could improve one thing, what would it be?

phases.name: Product Demo & Reaction Measurement
phases.objective: Show Command Console live, measure wow-factor & brand fidelity

phases.name: Purchasing Criteria Ranking
phases.objective: Force-rank 3 criteria: Speed, Brand Fidelity, No MOQs
phases.instruction: I'm giving you 3 factors. Rank 1-3 (1=most important). What's your ranking?
criteria: Speed — Minutes/hours to live, not weeks
Brand Fidelity — Mockups truly reflect your brand
On-Demand Fulfillment with No MOQs — Order what you need when
phases.follow_up: Why did you rank [#1] as most important?

phases.name: Pricing Validation & Authority Probe
phases.objective: Present $24K Growth tier, validate WTP, authority, cycle
phases.intro: We offer 3 tiers: Standard (free), Growth ($24K/yr), Enterprise (custom)
questions: Is $24K/yr in a range you'd seriously consider?
Do you have authority for $24K or does CFO need sign-off?
From agreement to signature, how many days does your cycle take?

phases.name: Pilot Offer & Close
phases.objective: Offer $4,800 Brand Drop Pilot, qualify conversion intent
phases.pitch: Rather than commit to $24K now, run a $4,800 Brand Drop Pilot—Week 1 mockups, Week 2 approval, Week 3 ship, Week 4 NPS survey
phases.close_question: Would you want to run a pilot?
phases.final_question: What would it take for you to say yes?
phases.next_steps: If YES/MAYBE: Send SOW + briefing email within 2 hours

icp_validation: Title matches People Ops Manager/Head of People?

confirm.definition: Prospect said yes, in range, or no objection; natural fit; unrealistic timeline/authority
characteristics: Prospect says yes / in range / no objection

gray.definition: Prospect hedges, asks about terms, conditional yes; some concern but not deal-killer
characteristics: Prospect hedges / asks about terms / conditional yes
Some concern but not a deal-killer

refute.definition: Prospect says no, too expensive, out of budget; fundamental mismatch
characteristics: Prospect says no / too expensive / out of budget

assumption_b_authority.validation_interval: HIGH confidence in VP-level direct sales

final_recommendation_options.action: Launch Growth tier immediately; execute pilot SOWs

critical_success_factors: Ask follow-up clarifications (push for clarity on hedged answers)
Measure demo reaction in real-time (not after call)
Get contact info + next steps before hanging up
Aggregate early (after call 3, check if pattern emerging)
common_pitfalls_to_avoid: Selling instead of discovering (70% listen, 30% talk)
Skipping demo (live show is critical for wow-factor measurement)
Not capturing verbatim quotes (synthesis memo needs evidence, not summaries)
Being too generous with scoring (CONFIRM only if truly unambiguous)
Not following up within 2 hours (details get fuzzy)
Sharing results before all 5 calls (pattern can shift with later calls)
Waiting until June 22 to aggregate (tally as you go; spot early trends)
